panels.description: Affected metric groups in the last 5 minutes, not a count of active Grafana rules or unique incidents. Warning ratios require at least 10 completed outcomes per flow and sustained degradation. No ordinary single user denial is counted.

targets.expr: (((count(sum by (flow,stage)(increase(auth_flow_total{job="dropleather-api",result="internal_failure"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(sum by (flow,stage)(increase(auth_flow_total{job="dropleather-api",stage=~"canonical_user|callback|seller_resolved",result="security_denied"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(sum(increase(auth_recovery_transaction_total{job="dropleather-api",result=~"failed|unavailable"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(sum(increase(auth_recovery_csrf_validation_total{job="dropleather-api",result=~"failed|unavailable",reason="unexpected"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(sum by (class)(increase(auth_session_validation_total{job="dropleather-api",class=~"security|integrity"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)) + (count(sum by (flow,stage)(increase(auth_flow_total{job="dropleather-api",stage=~"session_created|seller_resolved|callback|provider_dispatch|password_updated|session_revoked",result="infrastructure_failure"}[5m])) > 0) or vector(0)) + (max(label_replace((sum(increase(auth_flow_total{job="dropleather-api",result="infrastructure_failure"}[5m])) or vector(0)),"signal","flow","","") or label_replace((sum(increase(auth_session_validation_total{job="dropleather-api",class="infrastructure"}[5m])) or vector(0)),"signal","session","","")) > bool 1)) and on() ((min(up{job="dropleather-api"}) == 1) and on() (count(auth_flow_total{job="dropleather-api"}) > 0) and on() (count(auth_session_validation_total{job="dropleather-api"}) > 0))) or vector(-1)
